name: Intrinsic Unique-Sink Orientation
statement: The one-inclusion graph of the ample class has an orientation $o$ such that the outgoing neighbors of every concept lie with it in a contained cube whose support is its out-map, and the restriction of $o$ to every contained cube has a unique sink.
hypotheses: Finite ample binary class; cubes and orientations are intrinsic to the class rather than to the ambient hypercube.
comments: Existence of such an orientation is equivalent to existence of a CCMW representation map. Acyclicity is the additional condition characterizing dismantlable ample classes.
